围绕多媒体内容的理解、真实性与安全性，以及多媒体信息隐藏与隐写分析，开展方法研究: We study multimedia understanding, authenticity and security, alongside information hiding and steganalysis, through methods research and system development.
团队目前开展多媒体安全与信息隐藏两个方向的研究。多媒体安全方向涵盖内容理解、音视: MALab works in two research areas: multimedia security and information hiding. Our multimedia security research covers content understanding, audio-visual deepfake detection, adversarial defense and identity protection. Our information hiding research covers compressed-domain steganography, steganalysis and neural information hiding.
我们关注数字内容从生成、传输到使用过程中的安全问题，结合算法、数据集与系统评估，: We investigate security throughout the generation, transmission and use of digital content. Our work combines algorithms, datasets and system evaluation to study trustworthy multimedia in real communication environments.
研究声音与视频内容理解、深度伪造检测、实时交互安全和对抗防御，关注技术在压缩、噪: We study audio and video understanding, deepfake detection, real-time interaction security and adversarial defense, with a focus on reliability under compression, noise and real communication conditions.
语音、人脸及多模态伪造检测: Speech, face and multimodal deepfake detection
对抗防御与数字身份保护: Adversarial defense and digital identity protection
围绕音视频压缩参数域、隐写分析与神经网络信息隐藏，研究信息嵌入的隐蔽性、鲁棒性和: We investigate the concealment, robustness and detectability of embedded information through compressed-domain audio-visual methods, steganalysis and neural information hiding.

基于相同脉冲位置相关性的 AMR 隐写分析。: AMR steganalysis using correlations between identical pulse positions.
基于基音周期二阶差分的 AMR 隐写分析。: AMR steganalysis based on second-order pitch-period differences.
基于脉冲分布的安全 AMR 隐写。: Secure AMR steganography based on pulse distributions.
基于多尺度声谱网络的通用音频隐写分析。: Universal audio steganalysis using a multiscale spectrogram network.
基于最优概率差异、分块局部最优特性的视频隐写分析。: Video steganalysis based on optimal probability differences and block-wise local optimality.
基于多域一致性、泛化局部最优特性的视频运动矢量隐写分析。: Motion-vector video steganalysis based on multi-domain consistency and generalized local optimality.
多媒体安全方向关注深度伪造检测，涵盖语音、人脸和音视频多模态内容；信息隐藏方向关: Our multimedia security research focuses on deepfake detection across speech, faces and audio-visual content. Our information hiding research studies steganography, steganalysis and generative embedding. We investigate trustworthy digital content through new methods, datasets and system development.
